cases.answer: Arunika Medan Kesawan closed permanently on June 30, 2025.

cases.sql: SELECT MAX(list_price_idr) AS list_price_idr FROM analytics.dim_product WHERE is_active = TRUE
cases.answer: The list price is IDR 11,886,900.

cases.sql: SELECT promo_code FROM analytics.dim_promotion WHERE promo_name ILIKE '%Harbolnas 11.11%' OR promo_code ILIKE 'HARBOLNAS1111%' ORDER BY promo_code

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_head_office_employees FROM analytics.dim_employee WHERE is_active = TRUE AND store_id IS NULL
cases.answer: 30 active employees work at the head office.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS fully_refunded_orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'refunded' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
assumptions: “Placed in 2025” means the WIB business date falls in calendar year 2025.

cases.answer: 310 orders placed in 2025 were fully refunded.

cases.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.discount_idr) AS total_discount_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
assumptions: Total discount means the sum of order-line discounts (discount_idr), including all discount types, on orders dated in WIB calendar year 2024.
cases.answer: Total diskon pada tahun 2024, tidak termasuk pesanan yang dibatalkan, adalah Rp1.461.987.700.

cases.sql: SELECT courier, ROUND(CAST(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - shipped_at)) / 86400.0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_days_shipping_to_delivery FROM analytics.fact_shipments WHERE shipment_status = 'delivered' AND shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY courier ORDER BY courier
assumptions: Average duration means elapsed time in 24-hour days, including fractional days.
cases.answer: Rata-rata waktu dari pengiriman hingga tiba untuk paket yang terkirim adalah: AnterAja 2,85 hari; GoSend 2,84 hari; JNE 2,80 hari; J&T Express 2,84 hari; dan SiCepat 2,81 hari.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS whatsapp_tickets_2026 FROM analytics.fact_support_tickets WHERE contact_channel = 'whatsapp' AND CAST((created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) <= CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE)
assumptions: The data covers tickets only through 2026-09-30, so the count includes 2026 tickets available from January 1 through September 30 in WIB.
cases.answer: 1,231 support tickets were opened through WhatsApp in 2026.

cases.sql: SELECT c.channel_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = o.channel_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.channel_name ORDER BY c.channel_name
assumptions: Tahun 2025 berarti tahun kalender berdasarkan tanggal WIB.
Pesanan refunded tetap dihitung karena hanya pesanan cancelled yang diminta untuk dikecualikan.
cases.answer: Pada tahun 2025, unit terjual tanpa pesanan yang dibatalkan adalah: Marketplace 8.456 unit, Mobile app 12.608 unit, Physical store 38.848 unit, dan Website 8.908 unit.

cases.sql: SELECT SUM(visitors) AS total_store_visitors FROM analytics.fact_store_daily_traffic WHERE traffic_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND traffic_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
cases.answer: A total of 291,021 store visitors were recorded during 2025.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_purchase_orders FROM analytics.fact_purchase_orders WHERE po_status = 'open'
assumptions: “Still open” means purchase orders marked open in the latest available data, as of 2026-09-30.
cases.answer: There are 55 purchase orders still open.

cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(csat_score) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_csat_score FROM analytics.fact_support_tickets WHERE csat_score IS NOT NULL
cases.answer: The average CSAT score across all rated support tickets is 3.86.

cases.sql: WITH refunds_by_line AS (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount_idr) AS refunded_idr FROM analytics.fact_returns GROUP BY order_item_id) SELECT c.category_name AS subcategory, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr - COALESCE(r.refunded_idr, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN analytics.dim_category AS c ON c.category_id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN refunds_by_line AS r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND c.level = 2 GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY net_revenue_idr DESC LIMIT 3
assumptions: “In 2025” means the calendar year 1 January–31 December 2025, using WIB order dates.
Subcategory labels use the category_name field.
cases.answer: The top three product subcategories by net revenue in 2025 were Smartphones (IDR 20,104,901,000), Audio (IDR 14,757,281,300), and Computers & Accessories (IDR 11,061,043,200).

cases.sql: SELECT s.supplier_name, SUM(po.quantity * po.unit_cost_idr) AS total_purchase_order_value_idr FROM analytics.fact_purchase_orders AS po JOIN analytics.dim_supplier AS s ON s.supplier_id = po.supplier_id WHERE po.ordered_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND po.ordered_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND po.po_status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY s.supplier_name ORDER BY total_purchase_order_value_idr DESC LIMIT 5
assumptions: “Tahun 2025” ditafsirkan sebagai tahun kalender berdasarkan ordered_date.
“Nilai purchase order” ditafsirkan sebagai total nilai semua PO per pemasok, dihitung quantity × unit_cost_idr; PO berstatus open tetap disertakan.
cases.answer: Lima pemasok dengan nilai purchase order terbesar pada 2025, tidak termasuk PO yang dibatalkan, adalah: PD Fujiati Hidayat (Persero) Tbk (01) — Rp5.754.748.073; UD Hutapea Tbk (03) — Rp3.220.510.112; CV Dongoran Salahudin (02) — Rp2.793.420.652; PT Rahimah (Persero) Tbk (04) — Rp1.516.633.025; dan Perum Zulkarnain (14) — Rp1.269.061.824.

cases.sql: SELECT s.store_format, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY s.store_format ORDER BY s.store_format
assumptions: “In 2025” means the calendar year 2025, using WIB business dates.
cases.answer: In 2025, flagship stores sold 1,648 orders, mall stores sold 13,733, and street stores sold 6,019, excluding cancelled orders.

cases.sql: SELECT r.city, COUNT(*) AS online_order_count FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id JOIN analytics.dim_customer AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN analytics.dim_region AS r ON r.region_id = c.region_id WHERE ch.is_online AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2027-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY r.city ORDER BY online_order_count DESC, r.city LIMIT 1
assumptions: City means the registered customer's home city, not the fulfilling store's city.
Count all recorded online orders, including cancelled orders; orders without a registered customer city are excluded.
If cities tie, return the alphabetically first city.
cases.answer: Customers from Jakarta placed the most online orders in 2026, with 2,139 orders.

cases.sql: WITH store_out_of_stock AS (SELECT s.store_name, COUNT(*) AS out_of_stock_observations FROM analytics.fact_inventory_daily AS i JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = i.store_id WHERE i.snapshot_date >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND i.snapshot_date < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND i.on_hand_qty = 0 GROUP BY s.store_name), ranked AS (SELECT store_name, out_of_stock_observations, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY out_of_stock_observations DESC) AS position FROM store_out_of_stock) SELECT store_name, out_of_stock_observations FROM ranked WHERE position = 1 ORDER BY store_name
assumptions: Frekuensi kehabisan stok dihitung sebagai jumlah catatan toko-produk-hari dengan stok akhir hari 0 selama September 2026. Jika ada toko yang seri tertinggi, semua toko tersebut ditampilkan.
cases.answer: Arunika Bekasi Cikarang paling sering kehabisan stok, dengan 88 observasi stok produk 0 di akhir hari selama September 2026.

cases.sql: SELECT e.employee_code, COUNT(*) AS completed_in_store_orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = o.channel_id JOIN analytics.dim_employee AS e ON e.employee_id = o.sales_employee_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND c.channel_code = 'store' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY e.employee_code ORDER BY completed_in_store_orders DESC, e.employee_code LIMIT 1
assumptions: Interpreted “in 2025” as the calendar year 2025 in WIB.
Interpreted in-store orders as orders on the channel with channel_code = 'store'; returned one top associate, breaking ties by employee code.
cases.answer: EMP-00233 served the most completed in-store orders in 2025, with 152 orders.

cases.sql: SELECT r.region_group, COUNT(*) AS registered_customers FROM analytics.dim_customer AS c JOIN analytics.dim_region AS r ON r.region_id = c.region_id GROUP BY r.region_group ORDER BY r.region_group
cases.answer: Registered customers by region group: Bali 975; Jabodetabek 9,663; Jawa Barat 1,950; Jawa Tengah & DIY 2,478; Jawa Timur 2,612; Sulawesi 1,146; and Sumatera 1,176.

cases.sql: WITH promotion_counts AS (SELECT p.promo_name, COUNT(r.redemption_id) AS redemption_count FROM analytics.dim_promotion AS p JOIN analytics.fact_promotion_redemptions AS r ON r.promotion_id = p.promotion_id GROUP BY p.promotion_id, p.promo_name) SELECT promo_name, redemption_count FROM promotion_counts WHERE redemption_count = (SELECT MAX(redemption_count) FROM promotion_counts)
cases.answer: Ramadan Sale 2026 was redeemed the most, with 1,301 redemptions.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-03-31' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-04-06' AS DATE)
assumptions: Count all orders placed in the WIB date range, including cancelled orders, because the question asks for orders placed rather than revenue.
cases.answer: 281 orders were placed during the Lebaran week of 2025, from 31 March to 6 April.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS jumlah_pesanan FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) = CAST('2024-12-12' AS DATE)
assumptions: Menghitung semua pesanan yang dibuat pada tanggal WIB tersebut, termasuk pesanan yang dibatalkan.
cases.answer: Jumlah pesanan pada tanggal 12 Desember 2024 adalah 91.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST((ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE)) AS august_2026_orders, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST((ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE)) AS september_2026_orders, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST((ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE)) - COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST((ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE)) AS change_in_orders FROM analytics.fact_orders WHERE CAST((ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE)
assumptions: Count all orders, including cancelled orders, because the question asks for order count rather than revenue; report the change as September minus August.
Use WIB business dates for both months.
cases.answer: The number of orders decreased by 4, from 2,114 in August 2026 to 2,110 in September 2026.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS TIME) >= CAST('00:00' AS TIME) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS TIME) < CAST('06:00' AS TIME)
assumptions: “In 2025” uses the WIB business date; the time window is midnight inclusive to 6:00 a.m. exclusive.
Count all orders placed, including cancelled orders.
cases.answer: There were 864 orders in 2025 placed between midnight and 6 a.m. Jakarta time.

cases.sql: SELECT SUM(t.visitors) AS total_visitors FROM analytics.fact_store_daily_traffic AS t JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = t.traffic_date WHERE t.traffic_date >= CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND t.traffic_date < CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND d.is_weekend
assumptions: “Akhir pekan” berarti hari Sabtu dan Minggu, sesuai flag is_weekend di kalender.
cases.answer: Total pengunjung toko pada akhir pekan di bulan Juli 2026 adalah 7.486 orang.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) AS order_date, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.order_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE)), refunds AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns GROUP BY order_id) SELECT SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) FILTER(WHERE n.order_date >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND n.order_date < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE)) AS calendar_q1_2026_net_revenue_idr, SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) FILTER(WHERE n.order_date >= CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND n.order_date < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)) AS fiscal_q1_fy2026_net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id
assumptions: Calendar Q1 2026 is January–March 2026; fiscal Q1 of FY2026 is April–June 2026.
cases.answer: Net revenue was IDR 17,837,041,617 in calendar Q1 2026 and IDR 19,910,055,317 in fiscal Q1 FY2026.

cases.sql: WITH quarters AS (SELECT quarter, MIN(date_key) AS quarter_start, MAX(date_key) AS quarter_end FROM analytics.dim_date WHERE year = 2025 GROUP BY quarter) SELECT q.quarter AS calendar_quarter, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS new_customers FROM quarters AS q LEFT JOIN analytics.dim_customer AS c ON c.signup_date BETWEEN q.quarter_start AND q.quarter_end GROUP BY q.quarter ORDER BY q.quarter

WITH daily_orders AS (SELECT CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) AS order_date, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1) SELECT order_date, order_count FROM daily_orders WHERE order_count = (SELECT MAX(order_count) FROM daily_orders) ORDER BY order_date
assumptions: Interpreted “receive orders” as orders placed, grouped by WIB business date.
Counted all orders, including cancelled orders, because the question asks for order volume rather than revenue. Ties are included.
cases.answer: The company received the most orders on November 11, 2025, with 183 orders.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id
cases.answer: Total net revenue in FY2025 was IDR 74,011,993,834.

cases.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr) AS gross_sales_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
assumptions: “Tahun kalender 2025” berarti 1 Januari sampai 31 Desember 2025 berdasarkan tanggal WIB.
cases.answer: Gross sales selama tahun kalender 2025 adalah Rp78.069.530.500.

cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(o.total_amount) AS DECIMAL) / COUNT(*)) AS aov_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND ch.channel_code = 'app' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2027-01-01' AS DATE)
assumptions: “In 2026” means calendar year 2026, using WIB business dates.
AOV follows the glossary: order value after line discounts and before refunds, excluding cancelled orders; available order data ends 2026-09-30.
cases.answer: The average order value of app orders in 2026 was IDR 3,404,913.

cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(CAST(s.converted AS INT)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS conversion_rate FROM analytics.fact_web_sessions AS s JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = s.channel_id WHERE c.channel_code = 'app' AND CAST((s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
cases.answer: Tingkat konversi sesi di aplikasi selama tahun 2025 adalah 8,31%.

cases.sql: WITH eligible_orders AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.channel_id FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND (o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') >= CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND (o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') < CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)), sold AS (SELECT eo.channel_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold_units FROM eligible_orders AS eo JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = eo.order_id GROUP BY eo.channel_id), returned AS (SELECT eo.channel_id, SUM(r.quantity) AS returned_units FROM eligible_orders AS eo JOIN analytics.fact_returns AS r ON r.order_id = eo.order_id GROUP BY eo.channel_id) SELECT c.channel_name, ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(r.returned_units, 0) AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(s.sold_units, 0), 4) AS return_rate FROM sold AS s JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = s.channel_id LEFT JOIN returned AS r ON r.channel_id = s.channel_id ORDER BY c.channel_name
assumptions: Interpreted “2025” as calendar year 2025, using WIB order dates.

cases.answer: For orders placed in 2025, the return rates were: Marketplace 4.16%, Mobile app 5.51%, Physical store 3.94%, and Website 5.31%.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS active_customers FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) > CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE) - 90 AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) <= CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE)
assumptions: Applied the glossary definition: active customers had at least one completed order in the 90 days up to and including 30 June 2026, using WIB order dates.
cases.answer: We had 2,911 active customers as of 30 June 2026.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.store_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) AS order_date, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id, o.store_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE)), refunds AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns GROUP BY order_id) SELECT r.region_group, SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(f.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = n.store_id JOIN analytics.dim_region AS r ON r.region_id = s.region_id LEFT JOIN refunds AS f ON f.order_id = n.order_id GROUP BY r.region_group ORDER BY r.region_group
